oldenFormula: requestedValue = round_half_up_to_increment(unit_or_tier_median_squadValue * nominal_or_explicit_h3_count, 50). NeutralsDifficulty multiplies at runtime when isIgnoreMultiply is false.
scope: Generic HoMM3 random monster level objects (AVWmonN.def) and concrete typed monsters with H3M count==0 (CRTRAITS default-quantity sentinel).
sourceNote: VCMI/CGCreature rolls uniform CRTRAITS advMapAmount min..max when count==0. Nominal-by-tier counts are a mid-pool guideline for ports, not a hardcoded CRTRAITS dump. Olden squadValue always comes from installed Core.zip. Do not bake skirmish difficulty into requestedValue.
